## What's Changed
* Show weekly notes in the Calendar date panel by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/597
* Add optional live Markdown presentation in RAW mode by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/604
* Add Inbox and opt-in Archive for notes by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/606
* Add colorful sidebar icons, selection rails, and folio tag styling (#607)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/607
* Improve All Notes calendar dates and visual hierarchy by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/608
* Remove experimental colorful sidebar by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/609
* Add community colors and ring layout to Connections by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/614
* Refine Collections table visuals by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/615
* Prune low-value tests and dead recent-space id parsing by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/616
* Redesign appearance picker and add emoji icons (#617)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/617
* Overhaul All Notes activity heatmap by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/618
* Polish editor breadcrumbs and tokenize editor chrome colors [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/619
* Show main window only after first paint and bundle fonts (#620)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/620
* Add live note and passage embeds (#596) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/596


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/compare/v0.9.0...v0.9.1
